skill.description: Infrastructure as code guidance for Terraform, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, CI/CD, observability, and DevSecOps.

skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from DevOps references, sample IaC, placeholders, and code blocks. Confirmed risks include unvalidated output paths, partial secret disclosure, and a mutable third-party GitHub Action. No prompt injection, hidden exfiltration, or embedded real credentials were found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin every third-party GitHub Action to a reviewed full commit SHA and use automated dependency updates for controlled upgrades.
Normalize project and environment names, reject absolute paths and parent traversal, and refuse to overwrite existing files without confirmation.
Report only file path, line number, and secret type. Do not print any part of the matched secret value.

remediation.issue: Deployable examples include inline secret placeholders
remediation.suggestion: Prefer ExternalSecret or SealedSecret examples by default, and label placeholder Secret manifests as non-production examples.
Add preflight checks and comments before terraform apply, kubectl delete, docker push, and similar commands.

semantic_findings.title: User-Controlled Output Paths in Utility Script
semantic_findings.description: The Terraform and GitOps generators build output paths from CLI values before creating directories and files. Crafted project or environment names could write outside the intended scaffold tree.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Path construction uses direct CLI input and then creates or writes files. The risk is local and user-invoked, but the missing normalization is clear.

semantic_findings.title: Secret Scanner Prints Matched Secret Prefixes
semantic_findings.description: The secret scanner records file paths, secret types, and the first characters of each matched value. This can disclose sensitive prefixes in logs or chat output.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The scanner intentionally truncates values, which reduces exposure. It still prints part of any detected secret and the containing path.

semantic_findings.title: Mutable GitHub Action Reference
semantic_findings.description: The complete pipeline runs aquasecurity/trivy-action from the mutable master branch. An upstream branch compromise could execute unreviewed code inside CI.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The action is directly referenced as @master, which is mutable and lacks commit-level integrity protection.

content.value_statement: Infrastructure teams need consistent patterns for cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability. This skill provides structured guidance, templates, and local utilities for IaC delivery.
actual_capabilities: Guides Terraform module design, remote state, variables, outputs, and security patterns.
Provides Kubernetes deployment, RBAC, networking, autoscaling, Helm, and Kustomize examples.
Describes AWS, Azure, and GCP architecture patterns for production systems.
Supplies CI/CD and GitOps patterns for GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, ArgoCD, and Flux.
Includes Python utilities for IaC scaffolds, manifest checks, deployment generation, and secret scanning.
limitations: Does not verify live cloud state unless users provide outputs or run tools.
Generated examples require organization-specific review before deployment.
Utility scripts can write local files and run installed tools.
Cloud provider APIs, prices, and service limits may change.

use_cases.title: Plan a new cloud platform
use_cases.description: Create an IaC roadmap with networking, compute, state management, security, and observability decisions.

use_cases.title: Standardize Kubernetes delivery
use_cases.description: Design deployment, service, RBAC, autoscaling, and GitOps patterns for repeatable application releases.

use_cases.title: Review DevSecOps controls
use_cases.description: Assess pipelines, secrets, policies, logging, and infrastructure templates before production rollout.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Terraform starter plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Terraform project plan for an AWS web app. Include modules, environments, remote state, and security checks.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Kubernetes rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Kubernetes rollout for this service. Include health checks, resources, RBAC, network policy, and rollback guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Build a GitOps pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a GitOps workflow for dev, staging, and production. Include validation, promotion, sync policy, and observability gates.

prompt_templates.title: Audit production IaC risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this infrastructure design for reliability, security, cost, and compliance risks. Prioritize issues and propose remediations.

output_examples.input: I need an AWS IaC plan for a small web application.
output: A target architecture with VPC, public and private subnets, load balancing, compute, database, and state storage.
A module plan with environment separation, tagging, secrets management, and deployment checks.
A review checklist for security groups, backups, monitoring, and cost controls.

output_examples.input: Review this Kubernetes deployment before production.
output_examples.output: A focused review that flags resource limits, health checks, RBAC, network policy, secret handling, and rollout risks.

output_examples.input: Create a GitOps workflow for three environments.
output: Repository layout guidance for base manifests and environment overlays.
Promotion steps for dev, staging, and production with validation gates.
Operational checks for sync status, drift, alerts, and rollback readiness.

best_practices: Provide constraints, cloud provider, environments, and compliance needs before asking for architecture.
Review every generated template before deployment and replace placeholders.
Run security, cost, and drift checks before merging IaC changes.
anti_patterns: Deploy generated examples without adapting secrets, network ranges, and resource names.
Ask the skill to change production infrastructure without a plan and rollback path.
Store real credentials in manifests, state files, or chat prompts.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy infrastructure?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and scripts. Infrastructure changes happen only if you run generated commands or templates.

faq.question: Which tools does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, Flux, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and major cloud platforms.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Are the examples production ready?
faq.answer: They are strong starting points. Review security, naming, networking, secrets, and compliance before deployment.

faq.question: Does it access cloud accounts directly?
faq.answer: No. It does not authenticate to cloud providers unless a user runs separate tools with credentials.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide cloud provider, regions, environments, workload needs, compliance rules, budget constraints, and current architecture details.
